verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents standard RBAC (roles→permissions) as its core authorization model, and separately offers Auth0 FGA for fine-grained, relationship/document-level access control (e.g., in RAG pipelines), which matches the relationship-based authorization ask. However, FGA is referenced only briefly as an AI-agent add-on rather than as a fully documented, general-purpose resource-level policy engine within the core Auth0 evidence, and no independent/hands-on validation of FGA's relationship-based model is present. missing for 10: deeper first-party documentation of Auth0 FGA's general (non-AI) use cases and modeling capabilities, independent/hands-on evidence of implementing fine-grained resource-level policies, and clarification of how FGA integrates with core Auth0 RBAC for typical (non-RAG) applications.
